::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
SMIC's largest single fab commitment — a $8.87B (reported domestically as over ¥50 billion total investment), 100,000 wafer/month 28nm-and-below joint venture with the Shanghai municipal government in the Lingang Special Area, formally incorporated as Zhongxin Dongfang Integrated Circuit Manufacturing Co. (中芯东方集成电路制造有限公司).
:::

**Chinese name:** 中芯临港 (Zhōngxīn Língǎng)

## What does this facility make?

12-inch (300mm) wafers at 28nm and more mature process nodes for foundry customers.

## Why does it matter?

Part of SMIC's 2020-2022 wave of four mega-fab JVs (Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Shenzhen) aimed at building mature-node capacity for domestic demand, launched in the same window SMIC itself was added to the US Entity List. This entry covers the operational Phase 1 (20,000 wafers/month, running since late 2024) specifically — the site's actively-under-construction Phase 2 expansion is tracked as its own entry, `smic-lingang-phase2`, so this one's 'Operational' status isn't read as covering the whole site.

## Project Timeline

- **Sep 2021** — SMIC signs cooperation agreement with the Shanghai Lingang Management Committee for a $8.87 billion, 100,000 wafer/month 12-inch fab; registered capital $5.5 billion, SMIC holding no less than 51%
- **Nov 2021** — Joint venture formally incorporated as Zhongxin Dongfang Integrated Circuit Manufacturing Co. (中芯东方集成电路制造有限公司)
- **Dec 2024** — Phase 1 (20,000 wafers/month) reaches production
- **Jul 2026** — China Construction Eighth Engineering Bureau (中建八局) wins the Phase 2 general contract for the Fab9-P3 building and Fab9-P4 foundation works in the project's northern district
